title: Household maintenance
learning_outcomes: Explain building systems in the context of household maintenance.
Compare and distinguish observation versus diagnosis in the context of household maintenance.
Apply maintenance priorities in the context of household maintenance.
Evaluate and justify decisions about licensed trades in the context of household maintenance.

lessons.title: Building systems
lessons.outcome: Explain building systems in the context of household maintenance.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving building systems; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to home maintenance register.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain building systems from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of building systems; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Observation versus diagnosis
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish observation versus diagnosis in the context of household maintenance.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving observation versus diagnosis; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to home maintenance register.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain observation versus diagnosis from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of observation versus diagnosis; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Maintenance priorities
lessons.outcome: Apply maintenance priorities in the context of household maintenance.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving maintenance priorities; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to home maintenance register.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain maintenance priorities from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of maintenance priorities; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Licensed trades
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about licensed trades in the context of household maintenance.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving licensed trades; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to home maintenance register.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain licensed trades from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of licensed trades; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of building systems; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of observation versus diagnosis; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of maintenance priorities; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of licensed trades; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.

safety.notes: Draft educational framework only. Use fictional cases; no personal diagnosis, prescription, hazardous practice, financial/legal instruction or unqualified certification. Obtain qualified/local review before publication.
